plan.task: Verify npm test and npm run build succeed
plan.notes: npm test: 35 passed. npm run build: exit 0.

decisions: The calculation logic must live in src/split.ts and the UI must consume that module.
Use integer cents in the pure calculation so exact-sum behavior can be guaranteed.
Deterministic remainder distribution is implemented with the largest-remainder method and ascending index as the tiebreaker.
UI reads the bill as a pre-tax subtotal (field labelled 'Bill amount', hint 'Before tax and tip') to match splitBill's contract; the receipt shows the derived grand total.

Per-person share elements are plain spans rather than <output>, whose implicit aria-live would announce every share on every keystroke; one debounced role=status region announces the settled total instead.
concerns: Need executable evidence that splitBill behaves correctly in the required scenarios, not just that the implementation looks plausible.
Weight quantisation at 1e-6 precision may collapse extremely small differences between weights; watch whether tests or UI requirements expose that as a problem.
Receipt caption/foot originally used --paper-shade at 1.65:1 contrast; fixed with --paper-dim (5.3:1). --paper-shade is now reserved for the decorative dot leaders.
last_instruction: Implement the full responsive, accessible UI wired to splitBill in src/split.ts: users must be able to add/remove people, enter total, tax, and tip, choose even versus weighted mode, edit weights in weighted mode, and see each person's share update live. After that, run npm run build and report the branch diff, the full contents of index.html and src/main.ts, and the build output.
